{'translated': 'Two days ago (the 10th), the Home Affairs Department announced the "Bishop Hill Optimization Plan," which will phase out the illegal structures that have been placed on Bishop Hill in Sham Shui Po for years. The first phase covers the area from the foothill to the summit of the hillside sitting-out area at Tong Yam Street, while the second phase covers the area from the foothill to the summit near Berwick Street.'}

{'translated': 'Currently, the second-phase area still retains a number of fitness equipment and statues, and residents can be seen on-site playing shuttlecock, table tennis, and using the fitness facilities. As for the area around the Tong Yam Street hillside sitting-out area, it was already fenced off with wire mesh and hoarding last night, with security guards stationed there this morning to prevent residents from entering.'}
